comment: “Prevention of resource overuse” introduces a commons-based framing but may be interpreted as allowing restrictions on essential health use because an actor generates high demand. Heavy use may reflect legitimate population need rather than misuse.

anchor.note: p.55 l.Lines 272-277 read as the printed page; section 3.4.2 agrees

public.text: “Prevention of resource overuse” introduces a commons-based framing but may be interpreted as allowing restrictions on essential health use because an actor generates high demand. Heavy use may reflect legitimate population need rather than misuse.
public.suggestedRevision: Rename the principle Fair and sustainable use of shared capacity. Distinguish legitimate high demand from avoidable, abusive, inefficient, or uncompensated use, and require safeguards against restricting essential health services.
